description: Verify that DUT ceases its claim and re-probes after two ARP Reply conflicts on its committed Link-Local address (RFC 3927 §2.5, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Same post-claim conflict-cease behaviour as _06, but the conflict frames are ARP Replies (not Requests). RFC 3927 §2.5 treats both as collision signals — the LL has been claimed by another node and DUT must abandon it.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. DUT: 3 Probes → 1st Announce → post_claim entry observer fires:
   • UT-query DUT_LL → snapshot
   • Tester → DUT: 2 ARP Replies with sender_proto_ip = committed LL

3. Observation (re-probe window):
   • DUT → wire: a fresh ARP Probe with target_proto_ip ≠ snapshotted committed LL   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Claim observed AND a fresh Probe with a different LL after the Reply conflicts.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_claim_observed — DUT did not announce its committed LL
• Fail_no_reprobe — DUT did not re-probe after the conflict ARP Replies

verdicts.Pass: DUT ceased its claim and re-probed after two ARP Reply conflicts — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_claim_observed: DUT did not announce its committed Link-Local address
verdicts.Fail_no_reprobe: DUT did not re-probe after the conflict ARPs
